raw_text: UNCONFIRMED: Indian Navy ASW assets reportedly tracking a Chinese nuclear submarine in the Bay of Bengal east of the Andaman Islands. P-8I Poseidon and surface combatant deployed. Submarine assessed as Type 093A Shang-class SSN. Tracking ongoing for 72 hours. If confirmed, this is a major subsurface incursion into India's backyard.
